bahrain.title: Bahrain among five Gulf states close to starting Schengen visa waiver process
bahrain.summary: GCC secretary-general Jasem Al Budaiwi said Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman and Qatar are very close to beginning the procedures that could end Schengen visa requirements, with progress expected at the GCC-EU summit in Riyadh on 24 October. It is the start of a process, not immediate visa-free travel. Only the UAE has a waiver now.

bahrain.title: Non-oil exports fall 56 per cent in August as trade deficit widens to BD 210 million
bahrain.summary: iGA figures show national origin non-oil exports dropped to BD 153 million in August from BD 350 million a year earlier. Imports fell 16 per cent to BD 409 million and re-exports 28 per cent to BD 46 million, leaving a trade deficit of BD 210 million against BD 75 million. Saudi Arabia took a third of exports.

bahrain.title: Central Bank of Bahrain to triple its technology investment over three years
bahrain.summary: Governor Khalid Humaidan told Fintech Forward 2026 the CBB will triple its technology spending over three years, using supervisory technology and AI to track transactions in real time and spot fraud early. He said financial services make up about 20 per cent of GDP. Bahrainis hold about 70 per cent of the sector's jobs.

bahrain.title: Traffic police step up crackdown on illegal e-scooter use
bahrain.summary: The General Directorate of Traffic is intensifying inspections across all governorates to enforce Resolution No. 58 of 2026, with offenders facing up to six months in prison and fines of up to BD 500. E-scooters are limited to designated areas and 25km/h, riders must wear helmets and protective gear, and passengers are banned.

bahrain.title: Fintech Forward 2026 closes with more than 60 agreements signed
bahrain.summary: The fourth edition drew over 2,900 participants to Exhibition World Bahrain and saw 65 per cent more announcements and signings than last year. Deals included Beyon Money's operations being integrated with Barq Group's platform, subject to regulatory approval, and NBB joining Benefit's Trade Finance Registry pilot against trade finance fraud.

bahrain.title: Haj packages this season range from BD 1,970 to BD 14,800 per person
bahrain.summary: Prices announced by Haj operators start at BD 1,970 for a quadruple room in the basic package, up from BD 1,400 last season, and rise to BD 3,370 for a single room. The mid-range package runs from BD 2,370 to BD 4,370, while the VIP option with business class travel costs BD 8,500 to BD 14,800.

bahrain.title: Councillor urges ministry to clear home rainproofing backlog before the rains
bahrain.summary: Southern Municipal Council member Abdullah Daraj says some rainwater insulation applications from northern Isa Town and Zayed Town have been pending for more than 10 months despite meeting all conditions. He wants the Municipalities Ministry to set a clear timetable for approved cases nationwide, especially older homes prone to leaks.

bahrain.title: Bahrain keeps Tier 1 status in US human trafficking report for a ninth year
bahrain.summary: Bahrain retained the top ranking in the US State Department's annual Trafficking in Persons report for the ninth consecutive year. The LMRA chief credited the national referral mechanism, the Expat Protection Centre, workplace monitoring and the system that checks wages are paid regularly through approved banks.

crypto.title: Ledger investigates reports of $86 million drained from wallets sold by a reseller
crypto.summary: Ledger is examining devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis after an investigator said over $86 million may have been taken from hundreds of wallets. The figure and cause are unverified. Ledger asked the reseller to halt sales and told buyers from the past 90 days not to set up devices. There is no evidence its own systems were breached.

crypto.title: Bitcoin steadies near $82,500 after Trump rules out Iran strike before midterms
crypto.summary: Bitcoin recovered from a Thursday low near $80,300 after President Trump said the US would not attack Iran before the 3 November midterms, but it is still about 4 per cent down on the week. Ether lost 9 per cent to around $2,500. About $1.09 billion in positions were liquidated in 24 hours, 85 per cent of them longs.

crypto.title: US expects to seize about $1 billion in Iran-linked crypto this week, Bessent says
crypto.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US will probably seize a billion dollars of crypto this week as part of sanctions on Iran, without saying whether exchanges or stablecoin issuers are involved. Tether reported in September that it had frozen $550 million of USDT in 2026 under the same sanctions.

crypto.title: UK sanctions three crypto exchanges over alleged Russia sanctions evasion
crypto.summary: Britain named Xeltox Enterprises, the company behind Cryptomus, Heleket and Certa Payments, and Kyrgyzstan-based TokenSpot among 38 new designations, along with two payment platforms. Two of the firms are said to have handled transactions for A7, the Kremlin-backed network behind the rouble-pegged A7A5 stablecoin. UK assets are frozen.

crypto.title: XRP Ledger quietly fixed a 2015 bug that could have created XRP from nothing
crypto.summary: A security report published on Friday describes a counting error in the ledger's built-in exchange that could have let an attacker mint and spend new XRP, breaking the 100 billion supply cap. It was reported on 22 September and fixed in xrpld 3.4.1 on 25 September. RippleX found no evidence it was exploited on any public network.

crypto.title: Thailand to allow locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs from 16 October
crypto.summary: Thailand's SEC issued rules letting local asset managers list single-asset bitcoin or ether ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. Funds must hold at least 80 per cent in the tracked coin and use Thai-regulated custodians. Investors must acknowledge the risks, and brokers may not lend clients money to buy crypto.
